title: Ignore and untrack root IntelliJ IDEA metadata (`.idea/`)
body:
This updates repository hygiene so IntelliJ IDEA project metadata is not versioned. The root ignore rule is enforced and existing tracked files under root `.idea/` are removed from Git tracking.

- **Scope**
  - Ensure root-level ignore covers the entire IntelliJ project directory via `/.idea/`.
  - Remove currently tracked root `.idea` files from the index.

- **Changes**
  - **Git ignore policy**
    - Confirmed root `.gitignore` contains:
      ```gitignore
      /.idea/
      ```
  - **Tracked metadata cleanup**
    - Removed tracked files under root `.idea/`:
      - `.idea/fityeszTheGameWebsite.iml`
      - `.idea/modules.xml`
      - `.idea/vcs.xml`

- **Net effect**
  - IntelliJ project metadata is no longer tracked and will remain excluded going forward.
